title: YouTube channel videos
description: One row per video, plus free status rows that explain what was not delivered.

dataset.title: Videos
dataset.description: Every delivered video has channelInput, channelId, channelTitle, channelSubscribersText, videoId, url, title, views, viewsText, ageText, ageDays, durationText, durationSeconds, position and thumbnailUrl. Rows with a status other than OK carry a reason instead of data.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters, chargedEvents, byStatus, stopReason, datasetNote and counterMismatch. Status codes: OK, INVALID_INPUT, DUPLICATE, NO_VIDEOS_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, NOT_CHECKED_TIME, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING, NOT_CHECKED_CHARGE_UNVERIFIED. Stop reasons: spending-cap, billing-price-unknown, charge-error, dataset-write-error, deadline.
